PhonePe Growth Analytics Team,

In my role as Junior Data Analyst at Paywise, I directly owned and optimized a weekly sales-operations Tableau dashboard for multiple stakeholders, reducing preparation time from approximately three hours to under 20 minutes by switching from CSV exports to automated Postgres views and scheduled refreshes. This hands-on experience using Tableau alongside proficiency in SQL against production Postgres replicas aligns closely with your requirements for managing funnel and cohort dashboards.

I have executed around 30 SQL queries for ad-hoc growth and operations questions, documenting key queries for broader team use, demonstrating my strong SQL skills, including complex joins and query optimization techniques. Additionally, I built a monthly cohort retention analysis in Python using pandas and matplotlib that uncovered insight into user behavior leading to actionable improvements. I have also supported A/B test result readouts at a basic level through funnel and retention analyses, which fits well with PhonePe’s growth pod objectives.

I am eager to contribute my data analytics skills and domain understanding of Indian fintech payments while learning dbt and further refining cohort and A/B test analytics alongside your senior analysts. PhonePe’s structured 90-day ramp and collaborative environment offer the perfect setting to deepen my expertise and impact growth outcomes.

Best,
Karthik
